parsed.notes: The Leverage Ratio is debt-to-capitalization: consolidated total indebtedness divided by (total indebtedness plus consolidated tangible net worth). It is not debt/EBITDA, so it is classed as 'other'. The company must meet either the Interest Coverage Ratio or the minimum liquidity test, not both. Minimum liquidity amounts are in $ millions ($1.12 billion actual vs. $109.9 million required). Other covenants are not listed as ratios: consolidated tangible net worth ($3.75B actual vs. at least $2.78B required), the cap on investments in joint ventures and non-guarantor subsidiaries, and the borrowing base test. The Term Loan has substantially the same covenants as the Credit Facility. The company states it was in compliance at May 31, 2026.
